note: Every entry here is `assumed`, and that is not a placeholder to be filled
in later with something better-looking. Nobody has sat with a child and
counted interruptions for any of these, and no tracker lookup has been run
against them either, so `assumed` is the true state and writing anything
stronger would be the exact failure this app exists to refuse.
`fitted` and `measured` records are exercised in tests/ against fixtures.
They are absent here because producing one requires work nobody has done:
`fitted` needs a stated derivation rule and a real tracker lookup,
`measured` needs ten minutes, a child, and someone watching.
apk_path and sha256 are null because this app does not download. An
operator puts an APK on disk and records its digest; until then the
install path refuses rather than fetching, which is the intended
behaviour and not an unfinished one.
